checks.text: Before finishing, the owner is warned that the sale is below cost, and by how much
The owner is allowed to go on, because only the owner may sell at a loss

shots.caption: A 30% end discount: the total falls to 210, below the box's cost of 240
The owner may still finish it: only the owner can sell at a loss

notes: Staff are held back (see feature 43). The loss the owner chose is counted in the reports (see feature 75).
did: At the counter, as the owner, gave a retail sale a 30% end discount (the box cost 240 and sells at 300, so 30% off means selling at 210), then pressed Finish sale.
